note: Reviewer names omitted. Order is the Play page default, not by date. Not a complete set. In this sample 141 of 540 reviews are 1 or 2 stars (26%); the shown order is the page's default, so these counts are not the app's overall rating.

reviews.text: I used this app for years until the most recent update, and they broke it. I couldn't change medications I take daily, I'd save it, and nothing changed. I had to repeatedly save changes to my medication schedule before it would update. And my favorite, I'd get notifications asking if I had taken meds I had already marked taken. It was incredibly confusing. Their response time to a question took over a week to get an automated response. Check out Pillo it's simple and easy to use.

Started as a free app then locked users out requesting to pay a monthly plan. While it's understandable to need funding, I find it unfair to coerce users like that and think at least the consultation of saved data should be kept accessible to long time users. And there could be alternatives : propose a one time payment, lock only the addition of new medicine, have an add supported option...

Perfect for me. I was using a reminder app, but there were several draw backs to that. It was relatively easy to put a tapering schedule of a medicine. And the actual pictures is a plus, and that you can mark them all done at once. Update 8/13/26 The app has become unreliable for me. I have it set up for a song to play. It worked this morning, but did not work for noon, suppertime or bedtime. I have missed doses because of it. I set up Samsung Health for a backup.

It's easy to use and keeps me on track! I like getting my 100% at the end of the week, so I don't skip anything even when I don't feel like taking it. I like that I can snooze reminders if I'm out, pause certain medications when needed, and write notes about doses. And it pointed out some interactions between two of my meds that I was able to adjust with my doctor. Great, simple app. Thank you!

It works!! Easy to set up. Easy to make changes when my prescriptions change. The app does what it is supposed to do - remind me to take my pills. You can set it for weekly reminders, daily reminders, or reminders throughout the day. If you forget to mark a pill as taken, the next day it will ask you if you took them. Thx!

I've updated this from a very low rating to four stars, because after a couple of years, it seems the problems that I was having with the app misfiling to the wrong date have stopped occurring. This was common on my phone before that. sofa quite some time, it's been working really well, and I've been able to trust the app to put my events on the right date.

pretty close to what I need. their feedback button does not work at all, it tries to open some email file sending it to myself? it's just busted. there's one primary annoyance of the whole thing and that is always having to do a secondary click after you take something if it's more than like 5 minutes from the reminder time you set. saying if you took it "now" or earlier. That's just annoying, and should be able to be disabled or adjusted.

I take Nurtec every other day and this app cannot keep that straight even though there is a setting for it. It's a very expensive med and if you take too many you will not get more for that month. I've deleted and entered it multiple times and it's still telling me to take it daily even though I can see that it's set for every other day. I truly don't know if I accidentally took two in a row or not. incredibly disappointing.

Why do you hide "add a Doctor" under appointments? It should be a stand alone option like appointments. And I don't want all your extra tips, & extra health info. I'm paying for a pill reminder & not a health education. I'm seeing too many 'contact us at' in response to user questions. It only takes 8 words to say "oops, we screwed up. We'll fix your appointments." You're adding too many whistles & bells which turns a perfectly good app into a kludge. Hardly worth an annual subscription.

used to be the best app I'd been using it for years but it doesn't work well anymore doesn't service it's function well notifications don't stay up they randomly disappear that was one of the main things that made this app better than others was that it was harder to ignore. functionality has gone down the drain you click take and then all the other notifications will disappear all of a sudden you check and you've missed meds for your whole day because the notifications aren't working properly

Works great for me. But I only use it for one medication that I needed a reminder every 3 days. My phone calendar wouldn't do it automatically and neither would any other app that I tried . they would remind me a couple times and then I guess they would forget . I can forget on my own ! this app has been working great for four or five months

My go-to app to help me remember my meds for several years Some phones I have issues with getting the notifications to show properly, but I think that's more of a phone settings (and hidden task killers) issue. Because it's not every phone. Between this and my pill organizer I remember to take my pills probably 90-100% of the time. I'm AuDHD, and need all the help I can get with reminders. I do wish it were easier to move reminder times for groups of meds in one go instead of individually.

update: I use this app everyday and it is truly wonderful. Keeps me so much more on top of meds. As an ADHDer, this is vital. One feature I wish this had is the ability to track "as needed" medications without scheduling them. ------- was working fine, but starting a few days ago, it does the reminding, but the program force-stops whenever I try to access it. Can't open the program, can't acknowledge doses. May have to delete and move on to another app...

Updated review: I've been using this app for years now and it's saved me. I have more pills to take now and one is every other day, no problem. Let's me know when I'm running low on pills. Allows for easy skip or reschedule of a pill, and of course, reminds you to take your pill. You can even customize the icon of your pill to match what it looks like. Great app!

I'm general, I like the app. it's simple and straightforward and keeps my 16 or so medications straight, along with my 7 different dosing times a day. I live in the Central time zone, and spent a week in the Atlantic/Eastern time zone. 5 days after my return, all of my reminders vanished! Several hours later they returned, but now some of them have shifted times and are an hour earlier than they should be. it's quite a mess.

VERY intuitive to set up and use. I love the reminders and the options you have for responding to them. I also discovered the reporting option, which is useful, for example, to see how much acetaminophen you've had in a 24 hr. period. If you get sick and need to add new temporary meds to your daily regimen (ex. get the flu), it's easy to do, and then turn them off when you've completed the routine. Highly recommended for anyone who needs to manage multiple meds.

The constant sticky on upper left that says "manage & change profiles here" is annoying and keeps popping up. Tap it and it invites you to change the color by paying for premium. The interface is not seamless. Too much info & bland. If you're looking for a calendar type app that shows you a zoomed-out calendar w/icons, it's not this. When you click Report, the interface makes everything too big and you have to scroll. App could be much better. Just not for me but may be great for your needs.

It generally does a decent job keeping track of when to take your meds and warning you when you forget. Adding meds is pretty easy. You need a degree in computer science to take one away as it is NOT intuitive and the instructions seem to have been forgotten. Recently, my app has decided to. not change the date. I started using a new feature and I think the app is confused now. I would prefer the developers stop trying new things, and just work as a good alarm.

I've used this app for years now. I've really appreciated it. But lately, the constant notifications at the bottom for the "Updates" & "For you" sections are becoming annoying. Some are quite repetitive. Would be great if there was a way to adjust those in the settings! Also a way to download our records and medication history would be nice.

I've used this app for a few years. I like it's format. The database has been adequate for my needs. I like that I can do a medicine with short courses as well as long term maintenance ones. Update 2024: still like it and still use it. Not sure what else there is to say. But if I'm going to have an app remained installed on my phone for as frequently as I change phones over the past couple years then it's worth noting.

Edited: Was great but I think this last update screwed it up. A med I added for 21 days shows up to be taken forever, can't get that to change at all. That scrip ended 3 days ago and I'm still getting notifications even though I suspended it. And now the notifications don't click through to any med, just to the home screen. Did a force stop, we'll see if that helps. If that doesn't work I'll have to find another app. Old review: Easy to use, Super helpful.

This is a great app! I never forget a med now. I even have my vitamins and other supplements set for reminders. I also like having the list of suspended meds, if I don't delete them. It was very helpful when I reported to a specialist what my primary care physician had given me. I couldn't remember the name, so I looked at the list of suspended meds. I have shown the app to my doctors to share with other patients. It's pretty intuitive and has great help services.

Very helpful for reminding me to take my meds, before I leave the house. Most of the time, I've already remembered, but I have it set up to remind me at the time I generally leave for work just in case. I like that I can "snooze" the reminders so that if I'm away from the pills or on the phone etc, I can snooze the reminder for a period of time and then it goes off again. I also like the ability to choose the shape and color of pills and bottles, particularly since my eye drops all have different colored tops. I have also found this to be really helpful for reminding me to give my dog (entered as a dependent) his monthly heart worm pills, since I was always forgetting those for days at a time. I have it set as every 30 days, although it would be nice if I could set it for the xth of every month.

Absolutely incredible helps so much (and it's FREE)! I use it to track my most important (strong pain) medication. I sometimes also track my blood pressure and pulse, it does so many things; I can't even mention them all. With my pain medication; I can take an extra 1/2 pill per day (if I have "Breakthrough pain"). That means the bottle is only a 27 day supply. I entered that information… and the App alerts: next refill date, based on that; not a 30-day schedule. They thought of everything.

This is the best, easy-to-use app ever. I take some mods every day, however I just had joint replacement and now have a ver complicatedgroup of meds to take. Some are on a schedule but some are "as needed." This app handles it all. No risk of missing a med or accidentally taking too much if you use the app as directed. It also has a wealth of other features such as reports, med info, etc. I love this app

Works well. I use this to track whether I rage my vitamins daily. I wanted something really simple that would let me tick a box of I took them in am and pm. This thing does that, and does not get in the way. It also keeps the history so you can look back and see how consistent you are. As long as they keep it simple and basic I'll stick around. I think less is more for stuff like this. Simple and easy so I can use it and move on asap.
1 person found this review helpful

The app is described as "free" on its website. However, it's only possible to track two medications without a subscription, which is only revealed once you've created an account. This type of "subscribe to unlock basic functionality" model is incredibly frustrating. Subscriptions should be for additional functionality that actually uses resources (like cloud storage), not for basic functionality. I would happily pay for the app, but to expect a monthly payment is too much. Disappointing.

Very easy to use! I like the pleasant and unique alert sound (noticeable but not annoying). Great reminders for scheduled daily meds, so you don't forget a dose, and also works to track occasional meds such as cough syrup, so you know when you took the last dose. If you don't take your med the first time, it notifies again every 10 minutes like a snooze alarm. I also use it to remind me to do my daily language lessons. Highly recommended.

Could've been perfect. Not suited for medicine with irregular schedules, including birth control. A "resume notifications in [time frame]" would be enough but they don't have that. A monthly view would also be helpful instead of daily only. Also they send constant emails about your "medication weekly summary" and there's literally no way to unsubscribe, the link is broken. The app offers no escape either.

I take a lot of meds and supplements, which means that I end up taking pills 6 times a day. Medisafe is the first app that has been able to handle my entire regimen without choking; and the fact that if allows you to input the shape and color of each pill is a great double-check. Well done, team! (Now if we could just get it to let us set a relative size...)

Been using Medisafe for quite awhile now and find it absolutely necessary for tracking my meds. The reminders are great whether it's once a day, every other day or just 3 times a week. Inventory tracking is extremely handy, set it to remind me when a certain amount of medications are left for a refill reminder and it simplifies that process a great deal. Tracks prescribing physicians, and amount paid, just great. Checks for potentially dangerous interactions. The list goes on and on. Just get it!
1 person found this review helpful

This is a fantastic app!!! The ONLY reason it didn't get 5 stars from me is because you aren't able to use an actual picture of the medication like other apps rather than trying to get as close to what it looks like with the choices they give. The selection for you to make the medication icon look like the actual medication itself is commendable but it never looks exactly the same nor do you have the option to put the markings down to be totally sure it's the correct pill, capsule, patch etc.

Love this app. I can track multiple people. I can have someone remind me to take medication, and I can remind someone else to take their medication. There are settings for as needed meds and scheduled meds. The main screen looks like a pill organiser, and you can pick what meds you register, what they look like, and dosage. Best of all, no ads and the reminders work!

Most important app on my phone. Love the new timeline. This is a life saver. Keep track of your meds, reminders of when to take them. I couldn't survive without this. Thank you for making it so simple to use. Love that pill icons look different its a big help. ** now i can use this even for non daily pills. Itll keep track of a 5 day z pack. It allows you to say when you took something thats as needed like an inhaler. Helps me keep track. Even more amazing.

When you take daily pills it's so easy to get in such a routine that you're on autopilot. So many times I go through the motions and on the way to work I can't remember if I actually took my pills or not! so it's important to mindfully take them. With the app, I religiously open the app while taking the medications and check off each dose. Also the app reminds you when it's time for your doses. Plus you can record measurements like blood pressure. it's helped me greatly stay on top of my health.
1 person found this review helpful

Update 12/22: Still true. Best tracking/reminder app! - 12/2019: best pill tracking app of all I've tried. It tells me specifically what pills to take at what time. I can indicate that I took my meds "on time" or "right now"/custom time if I'm off schedule, and it tracks my remaining pill quantity which helps me refill on time. It collect lots of data for me automatically; I'm not forced to enter everything manually, with lots of ability to edit that data so I'm not stuck with anything either.

Been using this app a long time to help me track and remember my meds. It's easy to use, works great, and has lots of customizable features and useful info without being overwhelming. It has an extensive database for medications and supplements and the newly added health trackers. It would be even better if I could see the health tracker line plots together, so that I can compare different aspects. Overall, very useful app, 10/10 do recommend.

I just can't figure out how to change "me" to be my husband's name. I probably should have done that at the beginning but was focused on entering the meds. Otherwise I really like it & have already recommended it to several people at the V.A. Update: I figured out how to edit & change things, & have even been able to add & delete pets' med schedules as needed. I eventually just added my name and went with that. But I do recommend this app to lots of people.

One of my most favorite apps. It's not too pushy, and it's not too lenient. Just the right amount of respectful insistence. The handling of this task seems to be almost intuitive. The "Shaky Pill" noise. Twice a day. Every day. I love the freedom of knowing that someone else is keeping track of this. I can honestly say that "Medisafe" never let me down. Transition was seamless when I changed to a new phone. Now that you've asked me, I come to realize that it is a comforting constant in my life.

Best medicine tracking app I have used. I use this as a personal tracking app to help me remember to take my meds on time. The pop up reminders are incredibly useful, and I love the ability to snooze medocations for a variety of times. The weekly reports are a great way to track consistentcy. The feature I didnt expect and I find incredibly helpful is the ability to check drug interactions. The database is large and really helps me figure our what over the counter medicines are safe.

This app was a life saver when the last medication tracking app I was using got bought out, without any warning to users that there would be any changes and charges no less!!! I tried a couple of different apps before downloading Medisafe. Medisafe has all of the tracking options I need and MORE. It was a VERY easy transition! And I love that you can just shake your phone to mark that you took your scheduled doses.

This app is very complicated to set up and use. I have numerous prescriptions and it has taken me hours to enter all my data. I want something much simpler. I don't need all the bells and whistles! I can't figure out how to make a list of everything I take! One scrip is stuck in an 'inactive' category w/no apparent way to make it active, and some meds show up in one list but not another. Worst part is the high price! I won't pay anything for this. I'll keep looking for something else.

I've used Medisafe for 4 years. I take medications 3 times each day. It is usually easy to remember first dose in the morning and bedtime meds. In between, I can get busy and miss a dose. I've tried alarms, tasks in my personal assistant software and other methods to remind me. Nothing worked as well as this app. It is easy to setup and use. Refill reminders are very useful. App does what I need!

This would be a good app just to remind you to take your meds, but that's about it. (The reminders were actually annoying to me.) You can't print a med list out and, although it asks for a lot of information about refills, it doesn't actually assist you in ordering refills. I spent a lot of time entering all the info about my meds, only to find that the app doesn't do what I needed it for. I deleted it.

It was great until they moved the "measurements" over to "health trackers," so you have to set up times for everything you want to track or add a new tracker everytime you need to note a measurement but it doesn't coincide with the pre-established tracker. Now tracking blood sugar means setting up a new tracker at any time of day, instead of just letting me add it to the list of measurements I already had for it. Super inconvenient - not everything to be tracked falls neatly on a schedule.

It's been 3 years since I started using this app. This has definitely stayed consistently the best medication tracker I've use. Added one star because they added variations of times you need to take your medication. With different kinds of reoccurring reminders. Also helps me keep track of how long I need to take a medication before swapping to a new one as well as refill reminders.

It does what I got the app to do, which is reminding and annoying me to take my meds on time. The reminder pops up every 10 minutes for about an hour from when your medication are due. If you missed by hours, then there is a pop up when you first check your phone. I have been using it for months, and it really helped me take my meds. job well done.

This app is super useful for my regularly scheduled meds, easy to enter everything once I figured it out. Where I have a big problem is with my "as needed" pain killers and muscle relaxers. These meds have a set limit I can take per day, but I only have to take them when I really need them, not on a schedule. It would be nice if there was a way to enter those and keep track of how many doses I've taken to keep me from accidentally taking too many.

UPDATE: 5/14/22 The app works quite well now and instances of it crashing have been significantly reduced. It definitely is a very useful app and I enjoy keeping track of my medications and dosages. My only wish is that I could edit the time the med was taken whenever I need to. If I take the med a few hours late, the option to adjust the time it was taken pops up. But, when I've taken the medication and log it less than an hour late, I cannot adjust the time the medication was taken at all.

Being someone who has to take medication on a routine to maintain optimal levels in my body, this app does everything that I need and does it well. However, it also does more than that and I'm not taking as much of the advantage of those things as I should in terms of journaling and other tracking. I can say that I've NEVER been disappointed with any aspects of its service though; I've never once thought "I wish it would..." and then gone to look for another app to satisfy a need it didn't meet.
1 person found this review helpful

Incredibly helpful app and easy to use! This app reminds you to take your meds and also gives you a place to confirm whether you have already taken them. It lets you set reminders, which can be generic or specific to your medication. 8/20/19 Update: The app now has reminder troubleshooting to warn you if you have phone settings that will block the pill reminders. I don't take important meds and don't want to update my settings so I constantly see a warning icon. Docked 1 star for that.

Another app not understanding their target audience. I've been using this app a couple of years, recommending it to friends. It was great, until the latest introduction to a subscription. Because someone in charge doesn't understand that people who use a lot of medication are sick. And those people often don't work. And no work equals bare minimum income. Conclusion: the target audience can't pay this amount for the app, and I'm part of that group. I don't mind a fee, but this is too much! Bye

It's not easy to add a MedFriend. When it is successful, they only get notified when I skip medicine, not when I take it. There's no setting to switch it to notifying when I do take medicine, either. Also, you can't send tracker numbers unless you send a spreadsheet. The graph is nice, but I just want to send my family my glucose numbers.

This app is great for keeping track of when you take meds. It's very easy to add an off-schedule dose or change a single day's dosage amount. The icon customization makes it easy to associate with the right medication when I'm tired. I also use it as a reminder to use my night guard. Best of all, there's no obtrusive ads or badgering for a paid subscription. This is a dream come true when it comes to a health app.

This is a great app, for tracking when to take medication. The notifications startled me at first (thought I was hearing a rattle snake), but once I realized what the sound was related to, I had to laugh at myself. This is better than the pill box, as it reminds you it's time to take your meds. But your phone must be on, to get the notifications...But yes, a MUST HAVE, especially if you have several meds to take at different times of the day...I love it.

I installed this app a week ago to see if you would be useful. I would usually focus on an object so I could trigger my memory if I questioned whether I took my morning medicines. I tried using the pill containers with daily compartments but I got lazy. After trying this app for a week I realize that the app was a great solution, plus it does more. The 'reminders' are extremely flexible. What surprised me is the fact that I can monitor 'inventory' of my medicines and get notified when I am in need of a refill. Once you get the refill you add the quantities to the app and tracks your quantities. I was unable to import my medications from my pharmacists, however it was easier to type everything into the app.

It still sends notifications even during scheduled do not disturb hours for sleeping. It's extremely annoying to get pill reminders in the middle of the night there's no way to turn it off. The app is not flexible enough to schedule sleep time and be able to take medicine outside of those hours. Don't waste your time with this app unless you like to be woken up in the middle of the night.

I like this app for reminders to take your meds and for daily med tracking. It does NOT count down any of my pills right at all for refill reminder, though. I don't know why. I'm always having to recount my pills, then go in and correct the count. It's always saying I'm low when there's no possible way. For example, I can get a 30-pill refill, then 6 days later it's saying I'm low and need a refill. I only add the refill in when I reach 0 pills to prevent confusion between bottles.
1 person found this review helpful

I was reluctant to try an app that would remind me to take my meds, when mine are all taken with meals or at bedtime, all of which change from day to day. I finally tried MediSafe and was not surprised when it reminded me to take my pills at my "standard" times, though I ate or slept earlier or later. After a few days of inaccurate reminders, I started to see how reminders did help me to take pills that I would otherwise forget to take, and I could show the actual time taken in the Notes field.

Used to be good - now useless I used this app in the past to keep track of my medications and always have a list with me and markings etc. Somewhere along the way, they changed it. You are no longer in control of your medications, the app is. It puts times of dosage for you and you can no longer just say 2x/day etc. You can no longer put in markings on the pill. Each pill you have to go through whole list of drawings to find the right one. Other problems, but out of space. Find something better

The actual "add a medication" process is very easy to use and takes care of pretty much all the info I planned to write down. However, it wouldn't let me delete a medication. It's gone from my list of medications, but it still shows up on the notifications/calendar and clutters up the app. It basically makes the rest of the app useless because now I have doubles listed for certain medications and I can't get rid of them.
1 person found this review helpful

Easily a 5-star app, the best I've seen, with many settings you can adjust. I gave it 4 starts is for multi-device sync. It's installed and logged in on both my phone (for while I'm away) and my tablet (while at home). If I log something on one device, the other will not reflect the change, and will continue to remind you about a missed med YOU ALREADY TOOK. Whether you wait 10 minutes or 10 hours, they will NOT sync up, and must be closed and reopened. Should be real-time sync, not manual.

This app and the associated platform need work. I was already logged into the app on this device, but I noticed I needed to "confirm my account" in order for the information to be backed up to their platform. I went through the process, logged back in, and every single medication was wiped out from my settings. This is unacceptable and sloppy programming.

I cannot recommend Medisafe enough. I have ADHD and am in the process of finding the correct dose of the correct medication, and i honestly have no idea where I'd be without this app. I know that sounds super corny, but I would literally never remember to take my meds if I didn't use it. Medisafe allows you to track your meds and you can also use the journal fairies, so you can look back and see what meds had which effect. For example, I was taking Omega 3's daily a while back, and about two weeks in I threw up, and I realized it was an effect of getting used to it because I had been looking my consumption of the vitamin on this app. If you're a woman, I'd also recommend getting Clue or another app to log your menstrual cycle so you can see how your place in the cycle affects how well a medication works. Anyway, the biggest thing about the app for me really is just getting reminded to take my medicine. I don't know where I would be without it. Good luck guys

Thoughts after a couple months of usage. There's a lot this app does right, but two things they should add, 1. Add multiple ingredients as one pill. Some of my medication from the doctor has a list of 3-6 items within the pill. Right now I'd have to enter it as 3-6 different pills even though it's only one pill. Fix please! 2. A non-subscription premium option. I'd happy pay for a onetime lifetime subscription fee for this app, but I'm not paying a subscription fee.

I don't see any way to set the time to take a medication to a specific amount of time after taking something else. The first thing I take requires me to wait a specific amount of time before taking the next one. Would also love to see the ability to use a smart watch to mark a med as taken. Also be great if you could use a picture of the med instead of pre-defined shapes and colors. Good app overall but could use a few adjustments, especially the time needed between taking 2 different meds.

This app looks good but hardly works. I've written and written support and only get rudimentary responses. It requires a verification code to sign up. I have signed up several times over the last 6 days trying to use the app. They keep telling me to 'sign up'. How many more times do I have to do that?? When it did tell me I was successful I entered a long list of medications only to find out that the registration did not take and now there are no medications on my account. Gave up. Moving on.

I've been using this app for probably over a year now. I don't utilize all of the features. I just use the main feature of reminders a couple times a day. I like that I can completely customize how the reminders work - what names I want to put into the reminder, what color/form to make the icon, what time for it to pop up, being able to snooze it for multiple lengths of time.... I wish that my husband and I could BOTH have access to marking my son's medications.

I appreciate this app so much for many reasons. First, you can share with other individuals if u "take" or "miss" a dose. Better accountability and follow through. you are able to assign the shape, label, and color for each of the pills so it looks just like your prescribed pills do. Its easier for me to visually compare a little picture of what pills i need to take vs. about to take. Is easier than comparing the bottle label word to the medication word in app. This app has helped! Grateful to u

Despite the name, this app is not safe! It abuses notification categories in an attempt to extract more health data from users, which is a sign of badware and other potentially unwanted programs. When I disabled all notification types other than one for medication reminders (the primary purpose of the app), I still got notifications begging for additional personal data to be input to the app, even though this would provide no benefit to me as the user.

This app is effective and easy to use. You set your medication, dosage, and schedule, and it gives you a convenient pop-up at that time that tells you to take it. I appreciate that it requires you to respond to every dosage reminder, so you have to say "Skip" if you've skipped a dose or "Snooze" to postpone it. Super convenient, I recommend it wholeheartedly!

I like to use an app for a little while before I rate it. The medisafe app is absolutely the best for keeping track of medications, reminding me to take meds, and it even alerts me when I need refills. I am really glad there is a "add your doctor section". With that I noticed I had an appointment with my therapist and psychiatrist at the same time on the same day. Going to correct that on Monday.

I love this app! My brain fog has been awful, and this helps me remember whether I've taken my pills or not. Also, if I forget to print out a list of my meds to take to Dr appointments, I have them all listed with the dosages in the app, so no worries. Super helpful!
